response.original_title: The Greatest House My Father Built
response.overview: A koi pond with a waterfall. A towering birdcage. Huge rooms. Through a child’s eyes, a son remembers the grand house his family once lived in together in an autobiographical animated documentary. Not everything endured.
response.tagline: A father builds his dream home; his son grows up watching it fall apart.
response.title: The Greatest House My Father Built
